meta.title: Vendor self-participation requires show access and open tenders
gaps: the decisive step tests something else than the case's point: The fresh setup cannot switch the buyer company’s open_tenders setting between participation attempts, so the non-open-tender refusal depends on the configured company setting.

API-AUD-011 covers self-participation by a mapped vendor on an active open-tender event, but the available vocabulary cannot independently verify that the first caller was already invited or that the second caller was uninvited.
it does not read the record back to confirm what was kept or shown
it depends on a company setting this run does not change (the buyer company’s open_tenders setting) — a failure is reported as couldn't tell, not as a bug
warnings: act 2: QA vendor 2 is not invited in this setup — it acts as an uninvited vendor

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The invited QA vendor sends the request that reads the event, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
A second QA vendor sends the request that reads the event, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
The buyer sends the event groups participants request, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “You are not authorized to perform this action”, and never with a server error.
